newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-NYMEX crude needs $20+ gasoline to set pac.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-NYMEX crude needs $20+ gasoline to set pac.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
---------------- VIEWS FROM THE MARKET - JULY 24 --------------
* Analysts look for a convincing break of $20 on crude.
* Gasoline will continue to set the pace. Support is still good -- the market has managed to recover from sell-offs holding trendline support back to the third week in June.
Spot month continuation charts for NYMEX light crude and unleaded gasoline futures are forming an expanding triangle pattern.
This is a bearish signal and usually signals a sharp decline to come, analysts said.
However, the fact that both markets have tested and held several times trendline support extending from mid-June on the spot month chart continued to fuel some mildly bullish expectations.
Victor Yu at Refco in New York said gasoline would continue to set the pace.
"Support for gasoline is still good the market has managed to recover from sell-offs holding trendline support back to the third week in June," he said.
"The recent uptrend channel puts resistance around 62.50 cents and a break should take us back to mid-May highs though there is a small gap at 63.20-40 in the way first," Yu added.
Despite making some ground on Wednesday front month crude has continued to trade in a narrow range in light volume.
But analysts are looking for a convincing break of $20 if the chart-flagged break back to the downside is to be avoided.
"The market needs to get above $20.40 to really get some momentum of it's own, otherwise it will continue to follow gasoline," Yu said.

GNI Research said in their daily report, " Gasoline was positive as expected, but quite volatile, while (NYMEX crude) will be watched for a test of $19.75 and for a potential break to the psychological $20 number".
They said $19.90 would be an intermediate number while above $20, $20.25 would be the target.
Support is implied around $19.30-40.
The level of $20.02 represent a 38 percent Fibonacci retracement from the September crude contract low of $18.80 with $20.40 a 50 percent retracement.

A miniature head and shoulders formation on the heating oil spot month continuation chart which completes on the short term downtrend line from May 16's 58.90 cent high could signal some weakness to come.
But analysts said there was little momentum in the market and expected price action to follow the lead of crude and gasoline.
-- Colin Wooster, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7456
